mapper.select: SELECT id, asset_key AS assetKey, name AS name, display_name AS displayName, summary AS summary, layer_code AS layerCode, owner_user AS ownerUser, entity_status AS entityStatus, data_source_id AS dataSourceId, database_name AS databaseName, schema_name AS schemaName, table_name AS tableName, update_time AS updateTime FROM yak_metadata_asset WHERE id = #{id} AND source_type = 'METADATA' AND asset_type = 'TABLE' AND gone_at IS NULL
